Headline results for run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (read-only report via `python3 ~/poro/agent/report.py <run>`):

Coverage / detections
- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20; 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z, 3.314% of the time window)
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57
- DAS detections: 62 in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 above Mc)
- Pumping context: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days
- Catalogue: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07 (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016)

CALIBRATED — catalogue-based probabilities (Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5; LBNL/NCEDC catalogue magnitudes are calibrated):
  b     Sigma     P(M>=5.5)/yr   P(M>=5.5) over observed volume   P(M>=3)/yr
  1.0   -5.449    0.0001198      5.236e-06                        0.03719
  0.73  -5.319    0.004922       0.0002155                        0.2809
  0.65  -5.281    0.01474        0.0006484                        0.4653

UPPER BOUND — DAS-based, uncalibrated magnitudes (every DAS detection counted as an event at/above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts):
  b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842

Which is which: the per-b Sigma and P(Mw>=5.5)/yr values for b = 1.0 / 0.73 / 0.65 are the CALIBRATED catalogue-based (LBNL/NCEDC) estimates. The single DAS-based figure (b = 0.9849, Sigma -2.698, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr 0.07842) is the UPPER BOUND using uncalibrated DAS magnitudes and over-counts events, so it is not calibrated.
